contract: Golden Aura Trust: six core organisation/event pages and detail routes; ivory/charcoal/gold with the official logo and genuine event photographs; primary action Explore events, clear completed/upcoming states, contact recovery, accessible keyboard/forms/gallery, responsive 1440x900 and 390x844 layouts. Native registration, payments and live 3D are deferred.

accessibility.evidence: One h1 per route; labelled required inputs and consent; keyboard skip link has visible solid focus; mobile summary opens with Enter and closes with Escape; native dialog traps focus, closes with Escape and returns focus to its photo button; sending button disabled; response receives focus via status/alert. Large soft headings and body colours reviewed. Reduced-motion overrides are present in served CSS; preference emulation was unavailable.

responsive.evidence: All six core pages, an event detail, privacy and 404 were inspected at a CSS viewport of 390x844. Desktop layouts inspected at 1440x900. Document width stayed within the viewport. Screenshots exclude browser chrome/scrollbar. Gallery scrolling loaded all 21 images with no decode failures.

loading.evidence: Local SMTP acceptance fixture delays delivery; browser displayed Sending… disabled and Sending your enquiry… status. No external email was sent.

empty.evidence: Events page has no upcoming editions and presents an announcement plus a working contact action.

error.evidence: Actual unconfigured SMTP endpoint returned 503; browser displayed a delivery error, focused it and preserved entered name/email/message. Invalid form submission was blocked and focused the required name input.

partial.evidence: 2024 event has no confirmed prize fund, brochure or results links. Available date/venue/archive/contact information renders with no invented values or dead downloads.

success.evidence: With a local mocked SMTP transport returning acceptance, the real enquiry endpoint and browser form completed, displayed a confirmation and cleared inputs. Real mailbox delivery remains untested.

permission.evidence: HTTP fixture rejected unsigned CMS webhook with 401, accepted a valid signed webhook with 200, and rejected foreign-origin enquiry with 403. Live Sanity staff accounts/publishing are not yet connected.

renderedEvidence.observation: Readable hero and navigation; official logo; primary event and secondary Trust actions.
Hero copy and both actions fit; mobile menu; no horizontal overflow.
All gallery images loaded after normal scrolling; albums, captions, and enlargement controls fit.
Native image viewer has a visible close control and contained photograph.
Delivery failure is visible, announced and focused; form values retained.
Local fixture: sending button disabled while SMTP acceptance is pending.
Local fixture: acceptance confirmation visible and form reset.
Keyboard skip link visible and focused.

limits: Public domain, Hostinger deployment access, Sanity project/staff publishing, and actual SMTP delivery are not configured or verified.
Government checklist, contact details and team roles need final Trust sign-off.
Lighthouse unavailable: ECC browser service could not launch a headful browser without an X server. No performance score or production Core Web Vitals claim.
Full dependency tree has CMS build-tool advisories; deployed server dependency audit is clean.
Live 3D, registration and payments are deferred.
